content: Yogas chitta vritti nirodhah. (Yoga is the stilling of the fluctuations and modifications of the mind).
author: Patanjali
explanation: Patanjali's foundational sutra defining the supreme goal of yoga: when the turbulent whirlpools of thought, memory, and reaction settle into silence, our true nature as pure awareness is revealed.
practicalInsight: Take three conscious pauses during your workday. For sixty seconds each, consciously let mental commentary cease and experience the stillness underneath.
reflectionPrompt: What happens to my sense of peace when the mind's constant narrative is temporarily stilled?
